title: Choir festival
brief: The original delivery of five trunks of music folders to concert hall reception has fallen through. The district choir needs a replacement shipment in time for the combined rehearsal. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
Let’s book a replacement today for all five trunks of music folders to concert hall reception before the combined rehearsal. They need to travel together.

Ari, when can the trunks be ready for pickup? Sam, when can reception take them, and what’s the latest they can arrive? Drew, please confirm a service that fits those windows and send me the all-in quote. I can approve up to 99 crowns. Please wait for my approval before booking.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I can guarantee someone will be at concert hall reception to receive all five trunks together by 13:45 today. A 13:45 handover works. We can’t accept an unattended drop. Ari, when will the trunks be ready? Drew, can you quote a service that meets that deadline? Morgan, can you confirm whether the quote is within budget?

turns.speaker: Ari
turns.text: I can release all five packed trunks for pickup from 12:00 today. They need to travel together in one shipment. Sam, when can reception accept them, and what’s the latest they can arrive for rehearsal? Drew, what service can cover that window and what’s the quote? Morgan, can you confirm the budget so we can book today?

turns.speaker: Drew

I can book all five trunks together. Today’s quotes are below, with pickup first, then guaranteed staffed handover and the all-in price.

V974 picks up at 12:05, hands over by 13:33 for 52 crowns.  
V556 picks up at 12:27, hands over by 13:10 for 111 crowns.  
V292 picks up at 12:24, hands over by 13:22 for 79 crowns.  
V146 picks up at 12:30, hands over by 13:57 for 41 crowns.

Ari, when will all five trunks be ready? Sam, what’s the latest handover reception can accept for rehearsal? Morgan, what spend can you approve? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.
